title: What are the 3 rules of electricity?
desc:
1. Electricity always flows from a higher voltage to a lower voltage.
  2. Electricity always has work that needs to be done.
  3. Electricity always requires a path for travel.

title: How to reduce dewa bill in Dubai?
desc:
HOW TO REDUCE DEWA BILL IN DUBAI
  • To avoid peak hour rates from DEWA, refrain from using laundry machines and dishwashers during certain times.
  • Turn off the appliances to conserve energy and lower your DEWA bill.
  • By performing regular maintenance on your air conditioning unit, you can lower your DEWA bill.
  • Many people lower their DEWA bills by installing halogen incandescent, CFL, or LED light bulbs.

title: How often should I check my home's electrical system?
desc: It is advised to have professional maintenance or a safety check at least once a year to identify hidden issues such as worn wiring or faulty switches.

title: When should I contact an emergency electrician?
desc:
Contact professionals immediately if you notice hot outlets, persistent burning smells, charred switches, or if the distribution board (DB box) keeps tripping.
  • hot outlets
  • persistent burning smells
  • charred switches
  • the distribution board (DB box) keeps tripping

title: What are the causes of electrical fires in Dubai?
desc:
Common causes include overloading extension cords with high-power appliances, faulty wiring in older buildings, and a lack of maintenance.
  • overloading extension cords with high-power appliances
  • faulty wiring in older buildings
  • a lack of maintenance

title: What are the signs of an electrical power overload?
desc:
Lights covering when appliances start, frequent circuit trips, and warm electrical sockets are common concerns.
  • Lights covering when appliances start
  • frequent circuit trips
  • warm electrical sockets

title: What causes my circuit breaker to trip frequently?
desc: This issue is often due to overloading circuits or a faulty breaker.
